title: Clinical trial of a TabPFN-based machine learning prediction tool for acute kidney injury in acute myocardial infarction
summary: Acute kidney injury is a common and significant complication in patients who have had a heart attack. It can worsen the patient’s prognosis and is associated with a higher risk of complications and death. Despite known risk factors, high-risk patients are often not identified early enough in clinical practice. Therefore, this project uses a predictive model based on a novel algorithm called TabPFN to predict acute kidney injury in patients with a heart attack. The goal is to identify patients at increased risk early on and refer them specifically to a kidney specialist. This is thought to enable timely co-management to improve overall and kidney-specific treatment outcomes in patients with a heart attack.

interventions.name: Risk prediction for acute kidney injury based on machine learning tool
